definitions.explanation: A thin robe worn under a kimono, next to the skin or over a short undershirt; its collar shows at the neck of the kimono. The full-length kind is the {長襦袢|ながじゅばん}. The word comes from Portuguese gibão.

examples.japanese: ⟦{白|しろ}い→白い：00587_shiroi⟧{襦袢|じゅばん}。
⟦{着物|きもの}→着物：01309_kimono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{襦袢|じゅばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
examples.english: You wear a juban under the kimono.

examples.japanese: {襦袢|じゅばん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{襟|えり}→襟：06487_eri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧だ。
examples.english: It looks best when a little of the juban collar shows.

notes:
Part of the vocabulary of wearing kimono (⟦{着付|きつ}け→着付け：33897_kitsuke⟧). The juban keeps the kimono clean and lets it hang well; its visible collar is often covered with a separate white or decorative strip.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {長襦袢|ながじゅばん}: full-length juban
- {半襦袢|はんじゅばん}: short, waist-length juban
- {襦袢|じゅばん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{襟|えり}→襟：06487_eri⟧: the juban collar

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{肌着|はだぎ}→肌着：00080_hadagi⟧: undershirt, the layer worn next to the skin
- ⟦{着物|きもの}→着物：01309_kimono⟧: the kimono worn over it
